method: Manual inspection of actual app report captures and rendered offline guide screenshots, following automated filters, navigation and 108 retained-sample checks at 1440 and 390 pixels.
findings: The exact saved reports show the requested memory/simple modes, completed goals, evidence and integrated browser/canvas/chat controls.
Wide guide headings, metric cards, table and audit bars are readable without overlap.
First narrow guide table required horizontal scrolling and clipped the native-tick column in the initial view. Replaced its narrow layout with labelled cards, retaining all fields and table data.
Final narrow cards display task, reference, reuse, saving and native ticks clearly. Rechecked filters, navigation, no page overflow and every retained stage at first/middle/last samples.
Initial guide screenshots and checks are retained alongside final captures. Runtime source and timed results were not changed.
